result.topic_en: Euler argues that the calculation of water flow with friction holds only if the water pressure in the tube is everywhere positive, derives the pressure R at section BB, and obtains a condition limiting the length b of the lower tube BC.
result.transcription:
DE FRICTIONE FLVIDORVM. 357

51. Quod quo clarius perſpiciatur, notandum eſt, aquam eatenus tantum vbique tubi cauitatem explere, quatenus ad eius latera apprimitur: ſin igitur eueniat, vt preſſio aquae intra tubum alicubi vel euaneſcat, vel adeo fiat negatiua, ibi reuera latera tubi deſeret, vacuumque relinquet, ita vt motus aquae longe aliter ſit futurus, ac per calculum eſt definitus. Calculus enim locum habere nequit, niſi ſtatus compreſſionis aquae in tubo vbique ſit affirmatiuus.

52. Ponamus ergo ſtatum compreſſionis aquae in ſectione BB eſſe $=R$, atque ex §. 36. habebimus
$l=Re^{\frac{-\alpha b}{g}}+\frac{g}{\alpha}(1-e^{\frac{\alpha b}{g}})+\frac{k^4}{g^4}v-v$
ideoque $R=e^{\frac{-\alpha b}{g}}l-\frac{g}{\alpha}(e^{\frac{\alpha b}{g}}-1)+v(1-\frac{k^4}{g^4})e^{\frac{\alpha b}{g}}$
Iam ob $e^{\frac{\alpha b}{g}}=1+\frac{\alpha b}{g}+\frac{\alpha^2 b^2}{g^2}$, erit
$R=l+\frac{\alpha bl}{g}-b-\frac{\alpha bb}{g}+(1+\frac{\alpha b}{g})v(1-\frac{k^4}{g^4})$
et ſubſtituto pro $v$ valore ante inuento, habebitur neglectis terminis per $\alpha$ multiplicatis
$R=l+a-\frac{k^4}{g^4}(a+b)$.

53. Niſi ergo ſit $l+a>\frac{k^4}{g^4}(a+b)$, hypotheſis in calculo aſſumta locum habere nequit; ideoque tubi BC longitudo $b$ minor eſſe debet, quam $\frac{g^4}{k^4}(l+a)-a$. Quare ſi tubus BC infra ſit plane apertus, ſeu $gg=kk$, neceſſe eſt, vt ſit $b<l$: vnde hypotheſis euertitur, ſi eſſet $b=2l$. Caſu $gg=kk$, longitudo tubi $BC=b$ triginta pedes ſuperare nequit, vnde poſito $b=l$, maxima celeritas effluxus, ſeu quae minime a frictione impeditur,
Yy 3

items.quote: Calculus enim locum habere nequit, niſi ſtatus compreſſionis aquae in tubo vbique ſit affirmatiuus.
items.english: For the calculation cannot hold unless the state of compression of the water in the tube is everywhere positive.

items.quote: Niſi ergo ſit $l+a>\frac{k^4}{g^4}(a+b)$, hypotheſis in calculo aſſumta locum habere nequit; ideoque tubi BC longitudo $b$ minor eſſe debet, quam $\frac{g^4}{k^4}(l+a)-a$.
items.english: Unless therefore l+a > (k^4/g^4)(a+b), the hypothesis assumed in the calculation cannot hold; hence the length b of tube BC must be less than (g^4/k^4)(l+a)-a.

items.quote: Caſu $gg=kk$, longitudo tubi $BC=b$ triginta pedes ſuperare nequit
items.english: In the case gg=kk, the length b of tube BC cannot exceed thirty feet.
